articles.title: Bitcoin falls below $63,000 as risk assets sell off and the week's bounce fades
articles.snippet: Crypto dropped across the board on Friday in holiday-thinned trading, giving back the week's gains. With oil down 9% and the Iran deal signed, the question turns to whether this cycle gets an altseason at all.
